MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The right-angle braces felt useful alongside my recent wood screws because they could help secure joints in a wood assembly.",
    "The braces matched the practical fastening purpose of my recent purchases, giving me a clear reason to consider them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The test leads and electrical connectors require electrical work that my recent purchases do not suggest I am doing.",
    "Buffing compounds serve a finishing task I have not shown a need for, while glue and epoxy would need a specific bonding or repair purpose before I would choose them.",
    "Locking nuts do not complement the nails and wood screws I have been buying, and the hose fitting and peg hook depend on needs or compatible equipment I have not established."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seemed to treat a broad connection to tools and repair supplies as enough to make an item relevant.",
    "Bulk quantities seemed to carry over from my fastener purchases, although a large pack is only useful when I need that particular supply."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated purchases of framing nails and wood screws suggest a more specific interest in fastening and securing materials.",
    "The intended use and compatibility matter: a brace can work with wood screws, but locking nuts require bolts and electrical connectors require wiring work.",
    "My medicine cups and vacuum bags reflect separate practical needs; they do not make unrelated maintenance supplies natural next purchases."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical supplies but mostly missed the specific fastening needs that made the right-angle braces relevant."
}
